QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] We Must Fight
QuestInfo.0: After catching their breath, the scouts report the monster army is right under your nose. In a show of amazing support, the people encourage and comfort one another, calmly facing the situation. You can't give up! You must fight to reclaim your future!
